title: Oil prices plunge as Trump says renewed strikes on Iran unlikely
en: Crude oil futures fell sharply on Monday as geopolitical concerns in the Middle East eased. The West Texas Intermediate for December delivery lost 3.98 dollars to settle at 86.85 dollars a barrel, down 4.38 percent, while Brent crude for January delivery dropped 5.85 percent to 92.57 dollars. In an interview with CNN, U.S. President Donald Trump said renewed military strikes on Iran were highly unlikely as long as negotiations made progress, though he did not rule out further action. JPMorgan estimates the global oil market recorded a surplus of 1.4 million barrels per day in October, driven by recovering Middle Eastern flows and weak demand.
zh: 随着中东地缘政治担忧缓解，国际原油期货价格周一大幅下跌。12月交货的西得克萨斯中质原油期货下跌3.98美元，收于每桶86.85美元，跌幅4.38%；1月交货的布伦特原油期货下跌5.85%，收于每桶92.57美元。特朗普总统在接受CNN采访时表示，只要谈判取得进展，对伊朗再度实施军事打击就“极不可能”，但他并未排除进一步行动的可能。摩根大通估算，受中东原油出口恢复和需求疲软影响，10月全球石油市场供应过剩约140万桶/日。

title: Wall Street roars back as chip stocks rebound, Nvidia falls
en: U.S. stocks staged a broad rebound on Monday as a slide in oil prices eased inflation worries. The Dow Jones Industrial Average jumped 2.15 percent to 52,389.75 points, the Nasdaq rose 2.74 percent and the S&P 500 gained 2.35 percent, recovering much of last week's AI-driven losses. Semiconductor shares led the rally, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index soaring 6.85 percent and AMD surging more than 13 percent. Nvidia, however, dropped 4.22 percent to a near seven-month low as its board investigates reports involving its chief executive. Gold also climbed, with spot prices rising 1.4 percent to about 4,137 dollars an ounce.
zh: 受油价下跌缓解通胀担忧提振，美股周一全面反弹。道琼斯工业平均指数上涨2.15%，收于52389.75点；纳斯达克指数上涨2.74%，标普500指数上涨2.35%，收复了上周AI抛售造成的大部分损失。半导体股领涨，费城半导体指数飙升6.85%，AMD大涨超过13%。不过英伟达下跌4.22%，创近七个月收盘新低，其董事会正在调查涉及首席执行官的相关报道。黄金同样走高，现货价格上涨1.4%，至每盎司约4137美元。

title: State of the climate 2026 gives new meaning to 'off the charts'
src: 世界气象组织 · 环境
en: The world is on track for one of its warmest years on record, the World Meteorological Organization said. Its State of the Climate report, released on the first day of the COP31 summit in Antalya, Türkiye, shows the global average surface temperature for January to September 2026 was about 1.47 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels. The past 12 years were individually the warmest on record, with the past four years the top four. A strengthening El Nino, expected to peak in December, could push temperatures higher. Sea level and ocean heat content have both hit record highs, and the ocean absorbs about 90 percent of the excess heat trapped by greenhouse gases.
zh: 世界气象组织表示，全球正走向有记录以来最暖年份之一。在土耳其安塔利亚举行的COP31气候大会首日发布的《气候状况报告》显示，2026年1月至9月全球平均地表温度比工业化前水平高出约1.47摄氏度。过去12年是有记录以来各自最暖的12年，其中过去四年位居前四。预计12月达到峰值的增强型厄尔尼诺可能进一步推高气温。海平面和海洋热含量均创历史新高，海洋吸收了温室气体所截留多余热量的约90%。

title: Russia, U.S. and Ukraine resume talks in Abu Dhabi
en: Russia, the United States and Ukraine will hold talks in Abu Dhabi on November 10 and 11, resuming face-to-face negotiations for the first time in nine months. The discussions are expected to focus on post-war security arrangements, de-escalation and humanitarian steps such as prisoner exchanges. The U.S. delegation is led by special envoy Steve Witkoff, Ukraine's team is headed by intelligence chief Umerov, and Russia's by presidential aide Medinsky. France says it will also take part, seeking a voice for Europe. Officials caution that a breakthrough is unlikely, but all sides see the revival of direct talks as a chance to reduce civilian suffering.
zh: 俄罗斯、美国和乌克兰将于11月10日至11日在阿布扎比举行会谈，这是三方时隔9个月首次重启面对面谈判。会谈预计聚焦战后安全安排、局势降级以及战俘交换等人道主义议题。美方代表团由特使威特科夫牵头，乌克兰代表团团长为对外情报局局长乌梅罗夫，俄方代表团则由总统助理梅金斯基率领。法国表示也将参与，为欧洲争取话语权。官员们谨慎表示会谈不太可能取得突破，但各方都认为重启直接对话是减少平民苦难的一次机会。

title: Nvidia announces new investments in Korean AI startups
en: Nvidia said it would invest in four South Korean artificial intelligence startups, deepening its ties with the country's AI ecosystem. The chipmaker announced an investment in Point2 Technology, which builds radio frequency-based interconnects that move data between chips and racks in AI factories, with further investments planned in Motif Technologies, RLWRLD and Upstage. The announcements came at a forum co-hosted with Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT, where Nvidia leaders met more than 20 local startups working on foundation models, physical AI, infrastructure and semiconductors. Nvidia said the deals build on its Inception program, which has more than 1,000 members in Korea.
zh: 英伟达宣布将投资四家韩国人工智能初创企业，深化与韩国AI生态的联系。这家芯片制造商宣布投资Point2 Technology——该公司研发基于射频的互连技术，在AI工厂中实现芯片与机架之间的数据传输——并计划进一步投资Motif Technologies、RLWRLD和Upstage。相关消息在与韩国科学技术信息通信部共同主办的论坛上公布，英伟达高管在会上会见了20多家从事基础模型、物理AI、基础设施和半导体研发的韩国初创企业。英伟达表示，这些投资建立在已有超过1000个韩国成员的Inception计划基础之上。

title: Anthropic targets Nasdaq debut next week despite tech selloff
en: Anthropic plans to press ahead with its initial public offering despite last week's selloff in artificial intelligence stocks, aiming for its shares to begin trading on the Nasdaq as soon as next Thursday or Friday under the ticker ANT, The Wall Street Journal reported. The maker of the Claude AI models has meetings lined up with key investors this week, and a filing setting out its valuation range is expected soon. A week ago, investors expected the company to aim for around 1.5 trillion dollars, but after the rout some major investors are pushing for less, with some discussing a range of 1.1 to 1.3 trillion dollars. Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are advising on the deal.
zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，尽管上周人工智能股票遭遇抛售，Anthropic仍计划推进其首次公开募股（IPO），目标是最早于下周四或周五让股票在纳斯达克开始交易，代码为ANT。这家Claude AI模型的开发商本周已安排与主要投资者会面，说明估值区间的文件预计很快公布。一周前，投资者还预计该公司将瞄准约1.5万亿美元的估值，但在股市暴跌之后，一些主要投资者正争取更低的价格，部分讨论区间为1.1万亿至1.3万亿美元。高盛和摩根士丹利担任此次发行的顾问。
